name: Abu Asim al-Nabil, al-Dahhak ibn Makhlad
nameAr: الضحاك بن مخلد بن الضحاك بن مسلم الشيباني، أبو عاصم النبيل البصري
bornNote: He said: "I was born in Rabi' al-Awwal 122"; Khalifah ibn Khayyat: 121. He also said his mother was born in 110, so she was twelve at his birth (Tahdhib al-Kamal 13/287, from Amr ibn Ali).
diedNote: Dhu al-Hijjah 212, in Basra (Ibn Sa'd, Khalifah, Abu Dawud and others); Jabir ibn Kurdi: 211. Amr ibn Ali: aged ninety years and four months.

deathVariants.authority: Ibn Sa'd, Khalifah ibn Khayyat, Abu Dawud, al-Kudaymi and others
the book al-Zuhd, as cited by Mughaltay
deathVariants.source: Ikmal Tahdhib al-Kamal 7/25 (via Shamela narrator record)

role: Teacher of al-Bukhari; one of the shaykhs of his three-link chains

teachers.name: Jarir ibn Hazim
teachers.source: Tahdhib al-Kamal 13/282; Jarir also narrated from him (13/284: وهو من شيوخه)

students.name: Jarir ibn Hazim (d. 170), one of his own teachers
Muhammad ibn Hibban ibn al-Azhar al-Bahili (d. 301), the last to narrate from him
students.source: Tahdhib al-Kamal 13/285 (وهو آخر من حدث عنه); al-Khatib, Tarikh Baghdad, entry on Muhammad ibn Hibban

verdicts.ar: صدوق، وهو أحب إلي من روح بن عبادة
verdicts.en: Truthful; I prefer him to Rawh ibn Ubadah.

verdicts.ar: ثقة، كثير الحديث، وكان له فقه
verdicts.en: Reliable, prolific, and he had jurisprudence.
He was reliable and a jurist.

verdicts.ar: حدثنا أبو عاصم النبيل، والله ما رأيت مثله
verdicts.en: Abu Asim al-Nabil narrated to us; by God, I never saw his like.

verdicts.ar: كان يحفظ قدر ألف حديث من جيد حديثه، وكان فيه مزاح
verdicts.en: He had about a thousand of his best hadith by heart, and there was humour in him.

verdicts.ar: تسمعون مني ومثل أبي عاصم في الحياة؟ اخرجوا إليه
verdicts.en: Asked to teach in 213: "You would hear from me while the like of Abu Asim is alive? Go out to him."

verdicts.ar: متفق عليه زهدا وعلما وديانة وإتقانا
verdicts.en: Agreed upon in asceticism, learning, religion and precision.

verdicts.ar: كل شيء حدثتك حدثوني به، وما دلست حديثا قط، وإني لأرجم من يدلس
verdicts.en: Everything I narrated to you they narrated to me; I never once used the ambiguous formula, and I would stone anyone who does.

dhahabi.ar: قال عمر بن شبة: والله ما رأيت مثله، وقال أبو عاصم: ما دلست قط
dhahabi.en: Quotes Umar ibn Shabbah, "by God, I never saw his like", and Abu Asim's own "I never used the ambiguous formula".

bio: A Basran hadith master, born in 122 to a mother of twelve, who lived to ninety and became one of al-Bukhari's most senior shaykhs; al-Bukhari's three-link chains from Salamah ibn al-Akwa' run through him and through al-Makki ibn Ibrahim. Known everywhere by his kunya and his laqab al-Nabil rather than by his name, al-Dahhak ibn Makhlad. His clientage is disputed: some made him a mawla of Banu Shayban, others of their own stock, and Qa'nab ibn al-Muharrar a mawla of Banu Dhuhl. Ibn Hajar lists him in Hady al-Sari among the men of the Sahih known by a laqab. He is a textbook case of al-Khatib's "the earlier and the later" (al-sabiq wa al-lahiq): his teacher Jarir ibn Hazim (d. 170) also narrated from him, and his last student, Muhammad ibn Hibban ibn al-Azhar, died in 301.
